detail.longDescription: 💁🏻‍♀️ TIL: 📱👀 A recent # study tested whether taking # photos affects # memory for what people see. Across 7 experiments with 892 participants, recall was worse for # images that were screenshotted than for images that were only viewed. The researchers connect this to cognitive offloading, where people rely on devices to hold # information instead of encoding it themselves. 👉 https://www. sciencealert.com/science-weigh s-in-on-whether-all-those-photos-are-helping-or-hurting-your-memory # screenshots # cognition # learning # research # brain # technology # tech # smartphones # iphone # kids # education # parents # teaching # science # psychology # cameras # pictures
